draft: In this serene version of Mexico City, the sky is clear blue and sun shines on green parks filled with families. Vendors sell fresh fruits and vegetables as children play in sprinklers. The city feels safe, secure, and well-resourced. There's an abundance of clean water and public fountains, while people from all walks of life interact harmoniously. Social Conflict and Capitalist Hegemony are nearly non-existent; instead, there is a cooperative economy and strong sense of community.
